title.narrative: Great North Road Upgrade Zambia section of the North South Corridor

description.narrative: The project consists of the upgrade with only marginal changes to the existing alignment of about 372 km of the single carriageway Zambian Great North Road (GNR), also known as Trunk Road number 2 (T2), linking Mpika and Nakonde in the Muchinga Province, in North-Eastern Zambia at the border to Tanzania. The GNR is one of the six international trunk roads in Zambia with strong regional importance, as it forms part in particular of the North-South Corridor. The road carries significant international cargo and bulk commodities. In addition the project includes Technical Assistance

title.narrative: Passenger and freight volumes, by mode of transport

description.narrative: Passenger and freight volumes are respectively measured in passengerkm and tonnekm, and broken down by mode of transport. For the purposes of monitoring this indicator, passengerkm data are split between aviation, road (broken down between passenger cars, buses and motorcycles) and rail, and tonnekm are split between aviation, road, rail and inland waterways. As maritime data are not widely available, only tonnes (rather than tonnekm) data at the regional levelhave been shared.Data reported against SDG indicators can be retrieved from the official UN SDG Database and Statistics https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/unsdg.
